verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֣א יוֹסֵף֮ וַיַּגֵּ֣ד לְפַרְעֹה֒ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אָבִ֨י וְאַחַ֜י וְצֹאנָ֤ם וּבְקָרָם֙ וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָהֶ֔ם בָּ֖אוּ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וְהִנָּ֖ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ גֹּֽשֶׁן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō yō·w·sêp̄ way·yag·gêḏ lə·p̄ar·‘ōh way·yō·mer ’ā·ḇî wə·’a·ḥay wə·ṣō·nām ū·ḇə·qā·rām wə·ḵāl ’ă·šer lā·hem bā·’ū mê·’e·reṣ kə·nā·‘an wə·hin·nām bə·’e·reṣ gō·šen
verses.literal: So Joseph went and told Pharaoh . . . My father and my brothers with their flocks and herds and all they own have come from the land of Canaan and are now in Goshen
verses.literalPt: Tendo José entrado, deu notícia a Faraó, dizendo: Meu pai e meus irmãos com os seus rebanhos, e gados, e tudo o que têm são vindos da terra de Canaã; e eis que estão na terra de Gósen.

verses.original: וּמִקְצֵ֣ה אֶחָ֔יו לָקַ֖ח חֲמִשָּׁ֣ה אֲנָשִׁ֑ים וַיַּצִּגֵ֖ם לִפְנֵ֥י פַרְעֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·miq·ṣêh ’e·ḥāw lā·qaḥ ḥă·miš·šāh ’ă·nā·šîm way·yaṣ·ṣi·ḡêm lip̄·nê p̄ar·‘ōh
verses.literal: And he chose five of his brothers and presented them before Pharaoh
verses.literalPt: Tomou cinco homens dentre seus irmãos e apresentou-os a Faraó.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֛ה אֶל־ אֶחָ֖יו מַה־ מַּעֲשֵׂיכֶ֑ם וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֗ה רֹעֵ֥ה צֹאן֙ עֲבָדֶ֔יךָ גַּם־ אֲנַ֖חְנוּ גַּם־ אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer par·‘ōh ’el- ’e·ḥāw mah- ma·‘ă·śê·ḵem way·yō·mə·rū ’el- par·‘ōh rō·‘êh ṣōn ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā gam- ’ă·naḥ·nū gam- ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·nū
verses.literal: What is your occupation Pharaoh asked Joseph’s brothers Your servants are shepherds . . . they replied . . . . . . . . . both we and our fathers
verses.literalPt: Então, Faraó perguntou aos irmãos de José: Que ocupação é a vossa? Responderam-lhe: Os teus servos, somos pastores de ovelhas, tanto nós como nossos pais.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֗ה לָג֣וּר בָּאָרֶץ֮ בָּאנוּ֒ כִּי־ אֵ֣ין מִרְעֶ֗ה לַצֹּאן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לַעֲבָדֶ֔יךָ כִּֽי־ כָבֵ֥ד הָרָעָ֖ב בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וְעַתָּ֛ה יֵֽשְׁבוּ־ נָ֥א עֲבָדֶ֖יךָ בְּאֶ֥רֶץ גֹּֽשֶׁן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’el- par·‘ōh lā·ḡūr bā·’ā·reṣ bā·nū kî- ’ên mir·‘eh laṣ·ṣōn ’ă·šer la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā kî- ḵā·ḇêḏ hā·rā·‘āḇ bə·’e·reṣ kə·nā·‘an wə·‘at·tāh yê·šə·ḇū- nā ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā bə·’e·reṣ gō·šen
verses.literal: Then they said to Pharaoh We have come to live in the land for a time because there is no pasture for the flocks of your servants since the famine in the land of Canaan has been severe So now please allow your servants to settle in the land of Goshen
verses.literalPt: Disseram mais a Faraó: Somos vindos para peregrinar nesta terra, porque não há pasto para os rebanhos dos teus servos, sendo grave a fome na terra de Canaã; agora, pois, rogamos-te permitas que os teus servos habitem na terra de Gósen.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֔ה אֶל־ יוֹסֵ֖ף לֵאמֹ֑ר אָבִ֥יךָ וְאַחֶ֖יךָ בָּ֥אוּ אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer par·‘ōh ’el- yō·w·sêp̄ lê·mōr ’ā·ḇî·ḵā wə·’a·ḥe·ḵā bā·’ū ’ê·le·ḵā
verses.literal: Pharaoh said to Joseph . . . Now that your father and brothers have come to you
verses.literalPt: Disse Faraó a José: Teu pai e teus irmãos vieram a ti.

verses.original: אֶ֤רֶץ מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ לְפָנֶ֣יךָ הִ֔וא בְּמֵיטַ֣ב הָאָ֔רֶץ הוֹשֵׁ֥ב אֶת־ אָבִ֖יךָ וְאֶת־ אַחֶ֑יךָ יֵשְׁבוּ֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ גֹּ֔שֶׁן וְאִם־ יָדַ֗עְתָּ וְיֶשׁ־ בָּם֙ אַנְשֵׁי־ חַ֔יִל וְשַׂמְתָּ֛ם שָׂרֵ֥י מִקְנֶ֖ה עַל־ אֲשֶׁר־ לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā hî bə·mê·ṭaḇ hā·’ā·reṣ hō·wō·šêḇ ’eṯ- ’ā·ḇî·ḵā wə·’eṯ- ’a·ḥe·ḵā yê·šə·ḇū bə·’e·reṣ gō·šen wə·’im- yā·ḏa‘·tā wə·yeš- bām ’an·šê- ḥa·yil wə·śam·tām śā·rê miq·neh ‘al- ’ă·šer- lî
verses.literal: the land of Egypt is before you . . . settle your father and brothers in the best part of the land They may dwell in the land of Goshen And if you know of . . . any talented men among them put them in charge of my own livestock . . .
verses.literalPt: A terra do Egito está diante de ti; no melhor da terra faze habitar a teu pai e a teus irmãos; habitem eles na terra de Gósen. Se sabes que há entre eles alguns homens hábeis, faze-os maiorais dos pastores do meu gado.

verses.original: וַיָּבֵ֤א יוֹסֵף֙ אֶת־ יַֽעֲקֹ֣ב אָבִ֔יו וַיַּֽעֲמִדֵ֖הוּ לִפְנֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֑ה וַיְבָ֥רֶךְ יַעֲקֹ֖ב אֶת־ פַּרְעֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇê yō·w·sêp̄ ’eṯ- ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’ā·ḇîw way·ya·‘ă·mi·ḏê·hū lip̄·nê p̄ar·‘ōh way·ḇā·reḵ ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’eṯ- par·‘ōh
verses.literal: Then Joseph brought in his father Jacob and presented him before Pharaoh and Jacob blessed Pharaoh
verses.literalPt: José introduziu a seu pai Jacó e pô-lo diante de Faraó; e Jacó abençoou a Faraó.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֖ה אֶֽל־ יַעֲקֹ֑ב כַּמָּ֕ה יְמֵ֖י שְׁנֵ֥י חַיֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer par·‘ōh ’el- ya·‘ă·qōḇ kam·māh yə·mê šə·nê ḥay·ye·ḵā
verses.literal: How many years . . . have you lived Pharaoh asked . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Perguntou Faraó a Jacó: Quantos são os dias dos anos da tua vida?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יַעֲקֹב֙ אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֔ה יְמֵי֙ שְׁנֵ֣י מְגוּרַ֔י שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וּמְאַ֖ת שָׁנָ֑ה מְעַ֣ט וְרָעִ֗ים הָיוּ֙ יְמֵי֙ שְׁנֵ֣י חַיַּ֔י וְלֹ֣א הִשִּׂ֗יגוּ אֶת־ יְמֵי֙ שְׁנֵי֙ חַיֵּ֣י אֲבֹתַ֔י בִּימֵ֖י מְגוּרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’el- par·‘ōh yə·mê šə·nê mə·ḡū·ray šə·lō·šîm ū·mə·’aṯ šā·nāh mə·‘aṭ wə·rā·‘îm hā·yū yə·mê šə·nê ḥay·yay wə·lō hiś·śî·ḡū ’eṯ- yə·mê šə·nê ḥay·yê ’ă·ḇō·ṯay bî·mê mə·ḡū·rê·hem
verses.literal: My travels have lasted 130 . . . years Jacob replied . . . . . . My years . . . . . . have been few and hard and they have not matched the years . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . of the travels of my fathers
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhe Jacó: Os dias dos anos das minhas peregrinações são cento e trinta anos: poucos e maus têm sido os dias dos anos da minha vida e não chegaram aos dias dos anos da vida de meus pais nos dias das suas peregrinações.

verses.original: וַיְבָ֥רֶךְ יַעֲקֹ֖ב אֶת־ פַּרְעֹ֑ה וַיֵּצֵ֖א מִלִּפְנֵ֥י פַרְעֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḇā·reḵ ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’eṯ- par·‘ōh way·yê·ṣê mil·lip̄·nê p̄ar·‘ōh
verses.literal: Then Jacob blessed Pharaoh and departed from his presence
verses.literalPt: Tendo Jacó abençoado a Faraó, saiu da presença dele.

verses.original: וַיּוֹשֵׁ֣ב יוֹסֵף֮ אֶת־ אָבִ֣יו וְאֶת־ אֶחָיו֒ וַיִּתֵּ֨ן לָהֶ֤ם אֲחֻזָּה֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם בְּמֵיטַ֥ב הָאָ֖רֶץ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ רַעְמְסֵ֑ס כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוָּ֥ה פַרְעֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·wō·šêḇ yō·w·sêp̄ ’eṯ- ’ā·ḇîw wə·’eṯ- ’e·ḥāw way·yit·tên lā·hem ’ă·ḥuz·zāh bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim bə·mê·ṭaḇ hā·’ā·reṣ bə·’e·reṣ ra‘·mə·sês ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh p̄ar·‘ōh
verses.literal: So Joseph settled his father and brothers . . . in the land of Egypt and gave them property in the best part of the land the district of Rameses as Pharaoh had commanded
verses.literalPt: José estabeleceu a seu pai e a seus irmãos e deu-lhes uma possessão na terra do Egito, no melhor da terra, na terra de Ramessés, como ordenara Faraó.

verses.original: וַיְכַלְכֵּ֤ל יוֹסֵף֙ אֶת־ אָבִ֣יו וְאֶת־ אֶחָ֔יו וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־ בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֑יו לֶ֖חֶם לְפִ֥י הַטָּֽף׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḵal·kêl yō·w·sêp̄ ’eṯ- ’ā·ḇîw wə·’eṯ- ’e·ḥāw wə·’êṯ kāl- bêṯ ’ā·ḇîw le·ḥem lə·p̄î haṭ·ṭāp̄
verses.literal: Joseph also provided his father and brothers and all his father’s household with food for their families
verses.literalPt: José sustentou de pão a seu pai, a seus irmãos e a toda a casa de seu pai, segundo o número de seus filhinhos.

verses.original: וְלֶ֤חֶם אֵין֙ בְּכָל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ כִּֽי־ כָבֵ֥ד הָרָעָ֖ב מְאֹ֑ד וַתֵּ֜לַהּ אֶ֤רֶץ מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ וְאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן מִפְּנֵ֖י הָרָעָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·le·ḥem ’ên bə·ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ kî- ḵā·ḇêḏ hā·rā·‘āḇ mə·’ōḏ wat·tê·lah ’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim wə·’e·reṣ kə·na·‘an mip·pə·nê hā·rā·‘āḇ
verses.literal: There was no food, however in all that region because the famine was so severe the lands of Egypt and Canaan had been exhausted by the famine
verses.literalPt: Não havia pão em toda a terra; pois a fome era mui grave, de modo que desfalecia a terra do Egito e a terra de Canaã por causa da fome.

verses.original: וַיְלַקֵּ֣ט יוֹסֵ֗ף אֶת־ כָּל־ הַכֶּ֙סֶף֙ הַנִּמְצָ֤א בְאֶֽרֶץ־ מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ וּבְאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן בַּשֶּׁ֖בֶר אֲשֶׁר־ הֵ֣ם שֹׁבְרִ֑ים וַיָּבֵ֥א יוֹסֵ֛ף אֶת־ הַכֶּ֖סֶף בֵּ֥יתָה פַרְעֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·laq·qêṭ yō·w·sêp̄ ’eṯ- kāl- hak·ke·sep̄ han·nim·ṣā ḇə·’e·reṣ- miṣ·ra·yim ū·ḇə·’e·reṣ kə·na·‘an baš·še·ḇer ’ă·šer- hêm šō·ḇə·rîm way·yā·ḇê yō·w·sêp̄ ’eṯ- hak·ke·sep̄ bê·ṯāh p̄ar·‘ōh
verses.literal: Joseph collected all the money to be found in the land of Egypt and the land of Canaan in exchange for the grain they were buying and he brought it into Pharaoh’s palace
verses.literalPt: Então, José ajuntou todo o dinheiro que se achou na terra do Egito e na terra de Canaã, pelo trigo que compravam, e o trouxe à casa de Faraó.

verses.original: וַיִּתֹּ֣ם הַכֶּ֗סֶף מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַיִם֮ וּמֵאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַעַן֒ וַיָּבֹאוּ֩ כָל־ מִצְרַ֨יִם אֶל־ יוֹסֵ֤ף לֵאמֹר֙ הָֽבָה־ לָּ֣נוּ לֶ֔חֶם וְלָ֥מָּה נָמ֖וּת נֶגְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֥י אָפֵ֖ס כָּֽסֶף׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tōm hak·ke·sep̄ mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim ū·mê·’e·reṣ kə·na·‘an way·yā·ḇō·’ū ḵāl miṣ·ra·yim ’el- yō·w·sêp̄ lê·mōr hā·ḇāh- lā·nū le·ḥem wə·lām·māh nā·mūṯ neḡ·de·ḵā kî ’ā·p̄ês kā·sep̄
verses.literal: When the money from the lands of Egypt and Canaan was gone all the Egyptians came to Joseph and said Give us food Why should we die before your eyes For our funds have run out
verses.literalPt: Gasto que foi o dinheiro da terra do Egito e da terra de Canaã, vieram a José todos os egípcios e disseram: Dá-nos pão, por que morreremos na tua presença? Porquanto nos falta o dinheiro.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יוֹסֵף֙ הָב֣וּ מִקְנֵיכֶ֔ם וְאֶתְּנָ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם בְּמִקְנֵיכֶ֑ם אִם־ אָפֵ֖ס כָּֽסֶף׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yō·w·sêp̄ hā·ḇū miq·nê·ḵem wə·’et·tə·nāh lā·ḵem bə·miq·nê·ḵem ’im- ’ā·p̄ês kā·sep̄
verses.literal: Then bring me your livestock said Joseph Since the money is gone I will sell you food in exchange for your livestock
verses.literalPt: Respondeu José: Trazei o vosso gado; e por vosso gado vo-lo darei, se faltar dinheiro.

verses.original: וַיָּבִ֣יאוּ אֶת־ מִקְנֵיהֶם֮ אֶל־ יוֹסֵף֒ וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לָהֶם֩ יוֹסֵ֨ף לֶ֜חֶם בַּסּוּסִ֗ים וּבְמִקְנֵ֥ה הַצֹּ֛אן וּבְמִקְנֵ֥ה הַבָּקָ֖ר וּבַחֲמֹרִ֑ים וַיְנַהֲלֵ֤ם בַּלֶּ֙חֶם֙ בְּכָל־ מִקְנֵהֶ֔ם בַּשָּׁנָ֖ה הַהִֽוא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇî·’ū ’eṯ- miq·nê·hem ’el- yō·w·sêp̄ way·yit·tên lā·hem yō·w·sêp̄ le·ḥem bas·sū·sîm ū·ḇə·miq·nêh haṣ·ṣōn ū·ḇə·miq·nêh hab·bā·qār ū·ḇa·ḥă·mō·rîm way·na·hă·lêm bal·le·ḥem bə·ḵāl miq·nê·hem baš·šā·nāh ha·hi·w
verses.literal: So they brought their livestock to Joseph and he gave them food in exchange for their horses their flocks and herds and their donkeys Throughout that year he provided them with food in exchange for all their livestock
verses.literalPt: Trouxeram o seu gado a José; e José deu-lhes pão em troca de cavalos, de ovelhas, de bois e de jumentos; e os sustentou de pão aquele ano, em troca de todo o gado deles.

verses.original: וַתִּתֹּם֮ הַשָּׁנָ֣ה הַהִוא֒ וַיָּבֹ֨אוּ אֵלָ֜יו בַּשָּׁנָ֣ה הַשֵּׁנִ֗ית וַיֹּ֤אמְרוּ לוֹ֙ לֹֽא־ נְכַחֵ֣ד מֵֽאֲדֹנִ֔י כִּ֚י אִם־ תַּ֣ם הַכֶּ֔סֶף וּמִקְנֵ֥ה הַבְּהֵמָ֖ה אֶל־ אֲדֹנִ֑י לֹ֤א נִשְׁאַר֙ לִפְנֵ֣י אֲדֹנִ֔י בִּלְתִּ֥י אִם־ גְּוִיָּתֵ֖נוּ וְאַדְמָתֵֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tit·tōm haš·šā·nāh ha·hi·w way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’ê·lāw baš·šā·nāh haš·šê·nîṯ way·yō·mə·rū lōw lō- nə·ḵa·ḥêḏ mê·’ă·ḏō·nî kî ’im- tam hak·ke·sep̄ ū·miq·nêh hab·bə·hê·māh ’el- ’ă·ḏō·nî lō niš·’ar lip̄·nê ’ă·ḏō·nî bil·tî ’im- gə·wî·yā·ṯê·nū wə·’aḏ·mā·ṯê·nū
verses.literal: When that year was over they came to him the second year and said We cannot hide from our lord that our money is gone and all our livestock . . . belongs to you There is nothing left for our lord except . . . . . . our bodies and our land
verses.literalPt: Findo aquele ano, foram a José no segundo ano e disseram-lhe: Não ocultaremos a meu senhor que o nosso dinheiro está inteiramente gasto; o gado já pertence a meu senhor; nada nos é deixado diante de meu senhor, senão os nossos corpos e as nossas terras.

verses.original: לָ֧מָּה נָמ֣וּת לְעֵינֶ֗יךָ גַּם־ אֲנַ֙חְנוּ֙ גַּ֣ם אַדְמָתֵ֔נוּ קְנֵֽה־ אֹתָ֥נוּ וְאֶת־ אַדְמָתֵ֖נוּ בַּלָּ֑חֶם וְנִֽהְיֶ֞ה אֲנַ֤חְנוּ וְאַדְמָתֵ֙נוּ֙ עֲבָדִ֣ים לְפַרְעֹ֔ה וְתֶן־ זֶ֗רַע וְנִֽחְיֶה֙ וְלֹ֣א נָמ֔וּת וְהָאֲדָמָ֖ה לֹ֥א תֵשָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: lām·māh nā·mūṯ lə·‘ê·ne·ḵā gam- ’ă·naḥ·nū gam ’aḏ·mā·ṯê·nū qə·nêh- ’ō·ṯā·nū wə·’eṯ- ’aḏ·mā·ṯê·nū bal·lā·ḥem wə·nih·yeh ’ă·naḥ·nū wə·’aḏ·mā·ṯê·nū ‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm lə·p̄ar·‘ōh wə·ṯen- ze·ra‘ wə·niḥ·yeh wə·lō nā·mūṯ wə·hā·’ă·ḏā·māh lō ṯê·šām
verses.literal: Why should we perish before your eyes we and our land as well Purchase us and our land in exchange for food Then we along with our land will be slaves to Pharaoh Give us seed that we may live and not die and that the land may not become desolate
verses.literalPt: Por que morreremos diante de teus olhos, tanto nós como a nossa terra? Compra-nos a nós e a nossa terra em troca de pão, e nós e a nossa terra seremos servos de Faraó; dá-nos sementes, para que vivamos e não morramos e para que não fique desolada a terra.

verses.original: וַיִּ֨קֶן יוֹסֵ֜ף אֶת־ כָּל־ אַדְמַ֤ת מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ לְפַרְעֹ֔ה כִּֽי־ מָכְר֤וּ מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ אִ֣ישׁ שָׂדֵ֔הוּ כִּֽי־ חָזַ֥ק עֲלֵהֶ֖ם הָרָעָ֑ב וַתְּהִ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ לְפַרְעֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·qen yō·w·sêp̄ ’eṯ- kāl- ’aḏ·maṯ miṣ·ra·yim lə·p̄ar·‘ōh kî- mā·ḵə·rū miṣ·ra·yim ’îš śā·ḏê·hū kî- ḥā·zaq ‘ă·lê·hem hā·rā·‘āḇ wat·tə·hî hā·’ā·reṣ lə·p̄ar·‘ōh
verses.literal: So Joseph acquired for Pharaoh all the land in Egypt the Egyptians one and all sold their fields because the famine was so severe upon them The land became Pharaoh’s . . .
verses.literalPt: Assim, comprou José toda a terra do Egito para Faraó. Os egípcios venderam cada um o seu campo, porque a fome os afligia; e a terra ficou sendo de Faraó.

verses.original: וְאֶ֨ת־ הָעָ֔ם הֶעֱבִ֥יר אֹת֖וֹ לֶעָרִ֑ים מִקְצֵ֥ה גְבוּל־ מִצְרַ֖יִם וְעַד־ קָצֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- hā·‘ām he·‘ĕ·ḇîr ’ō·ṯōw le·‘ā·rîm miq·ṣêh ḡə·ḇūl- miṣ·ra·yim wə·‘aḏ- qā·ṣê·hū
verses.literal: and Joseph reduced the people to servitude from one end . . . of Egypt to the other
verses.literalPt: Quanto ao povo, fê-lo passar às cidades desde uma até a outra extremidade dos confins do Egito.

verses.original: רַ֛ק אַדְמַ֥ת הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים לֹ֣א קָנָ֑ה כִּי֩ חֹ֨ק לַכֹּהֲנִ֜ים מֵאֵ֣ת פַּרְעֹ֗ה וְאָֽכְל֤וּ אֶת־ חֻקָּם֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֤ן לָהֶם֙ פַּרְעֹ֔ה עַל־ כֵּ֕ן לֹ֥א מָכְר֖וּ אֶת־ אַדְמָתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: raq ’aḏ·maṯ hak·kō·hă·nîm lō qā·nāh kî ḥōq lak·kō·hă·nîm mê·’êṯ par·‘ōh wə·’ā·ḵə·lū ’eṯ- ḥuq·qām ’ă·šer nā·ṯan lā·hem par·‘ōh ‘al- kên lō mā·ḵə·rū ’eṯ- ’aḏ·mā·ṯām
verses.literal: However he did not acquire the priests’ portion of the land for it had been given to them by Pharaoh They ate the rations that - . . . . . . Pharaoh supplied so . . . they did not sell their land
verses.literalPt: Somente a terra dos sacerdotes, ele não a comprou; pois os sacerdotes tinham rações de Faraó e comiam as suas rações que Faraó lhes havia dado, pelo que não venderam a sua terra.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יוֹסֵף֙ אֶל־ הָעָ֔ם הֵן֩ קָנִ֨יתִי אֶתְכֶ֥ם הַיּ֛וֹם וְאֶת־ אַדְמַתְכֶ֖ם לְפַרְעֹ֑ה הֵֽא־ לָכֶ֣ם זֶ֔רַע וּזְרַעְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־ הָאֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yō·w·sêp̄ ’el- hā·‘ām hên qā·nî·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem hay·yō·wm wə·’eṯ- ’aḏ·maṯ·ḵem lə·p̄ar·‘ōh hê- lā·ḵem ze·ra‘ ū·zə·ra‘·tem ’eṯ- hā·’ă·ḏā·māh
verses.literal: Then Joseph said to the people Now that I have acquired you and your land for Pharaoh this day here is seed for you to sow in the land
verses.literalPt: Disse José ao povo: Eis que vos comprei hoje a vós e as vossas terras para Faraó; aqui, tendes sementes para vós e semeareis a terra.

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ בַּתְּבוּאֹ֔ת וּנְתַתֶּ֥ם חֲמִישִׁ֖ית לְפַרְעֹ֑ה וְאַרְבַּ֣ע הַיָּדֹ֡ת יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶם֩ לְזֶ֨רַע הַשָּׂדֶ֧ה וּֽלְאָכְלְכֶ֛ם וְלַאֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּבָתֵּיכֶ֖ם וְלֶאֱכֹ֥ל לְטַפְּכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh bat·tə·ḇū·’ōṯ ū·nə·ṯat·tem ḥă·mî·šîṯ lə·p̄ar·‘ōh wə·’ar·ba‘ hay·yā·ḏōṯ yih·yeh lā·ḵem lə·ze·ra‘ haś·śā·ḏeh ū·lə·’ā·ḵə·lə·ḵem wə·la·’ă·šer bə·ḇāt·tê·ḵem wə·le·’ĕ·ḵōl lə·ṭap·pə·ḵem
verses.literal: At harvest time you are to give a fifth of it to Pharaoh and four-fifths . . . will be yours as seed for the field and food for yourselves and your households . . . and children
verses.literalPt: Nos tempos da ceifa, dareis a quinta parte a Faraó, e quatro partes serão vossas, para semente do campo, e para o vosso mantimento e dos que estão em vossas casas, e para o mantimento de vossos filhinhos.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ הֶחֱיִתָ֑נוּ נִמְצָא־ חֵן֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י אֲדֹנִ֔י וְהָיִ֥ינוּ עֲבָדִ֖ים לְפַרְעֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū he·ḥĕ·yi·ṯā·nū nim·ṣā- ḥên bə·‘ê·nê ’ă·ḏō·nî wə·hā·yî·nū ‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm lə·p̄ar·‘ōh
verses.literal: You have saved our lives they said We have found favor in our lord’s eyes and we will be Pharaoh’s servants
verses.literalPt: Responderam eles: Tu nos tens conservado a vida! Achemos graça aos olhos de meu senhor e seremos servos de Faraó.

verses.original: וַיָּ֣שֶׂם אֹתָ֣הּ יוֹסֵ֡ף לְחֹק֩ עַד־ הַיּ֨וֹם הַזֶּ֜ה עַל־ אַדְמַ֥ת מִצְרַ֛יִם לְפַרְעֹ֖ה לַחֹ֑מֶשׁ רַ֞ק אַדְמַ֤ת הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ לְבַדָּ֔ם לֹ֥א הָיְתָ֖ה לְפַרְעֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·śem ’ō·ṯāh yō·w·sêp̄ lə·ḥōq ‘aḏ- hay·yō·wm haz·zeh ‘al- ’aḏ·maṯ miṣ·ra·yim lə·p̄ar·‘ōh la·ḥō·meš raq ’aḏ·maṯ hak·kō·hă·nîm lə·ḇad·dām lō hā·yə·ṯāh lə·p̄ar·‘ōh
verses.literal: So Joseph established a law that a fifth of the produce belongs to Pharaoh and it is in effect in the land of Egypt to this day Only the priests’ . . . land does not belong to Pharaoh
verses.literalPt: José estabeleceu por estatuto, quanto à terra do Egito, que a Faraó fosse dado o quinto; somente a terra dos sacerdotes não ficou sendo de Faraó.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֧שֶׁב יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם בְּאֶ֣רֶץ גֹּ֑שֶׁן וַיֵּאָחֲז֣וּ בָ֔הּ וַיִּפְר֥וּ וַיִּרְבּ֖וּ מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·šeḇ yiś·rā·’êl bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim bə·’e·reṣ gō·šen way·yê·’ā·ḥă·zū ḇāh way·yip̄·rū way·yir·bū mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: Now the Israelites settled in the land of Egypt in the region of Goshen They acquired property there and became fruitful and increased greatly in number
verses.literalPt: Israel habitou na terra do Egito, na terra de Gósen; nela, adquiriram possessões, frutificaram e se multiplicaram duma maneira extraordinária.

verses.original: וַיְחִ֤י יַעֲקֹב֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם שְׁבַ֥ע עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָ֑ה וַיְהִ֤י יְמֵֽי־ יַעֲקֹב֙ שְׁנֵ֣י חַיָּ֔יו שֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֔ים וְאַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּמְאַ֖ת שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḥî ya·‘ă·qōḇ bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim šə·ḇa‘ ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh way·hî yə·mê- ya·‘ă·qōḇ šə·nê ḥay·yāw še·ḇa‘ šā·nîm wə·’ar·bā·‘îm ū·mə·’aṯ šā·nāh
verses.literal: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years and the length of his life . . . was . . . . . . 147 . . . . . . years
verses.literalPt: Jacó viveu na terra do Egito dezessete anos; assim os dias de Jacó, os anos da sua vida, foram cento e quarenta e sete anos.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרְב֣וּ יְמֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֘ל לָמוּת֒ וַיִּקְרָ֣א׀ לִבְנ֣וֹ לְיוֹסֵ֗ף וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ אִם־ נָ֨א מָצָ֤אתִי חֵן֙ בְּעֵינֶ֔יךָ שִֽׂים־ נָ֥א יָדְךָ֖ תַּ֣חַת יְרֵכִ֑י וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ עִמָּדִי֙ חֶ֣סֶד וֶאֱמֶ֔ת אַל־ נָ֥א תִקְבְּרֵ֖נִי בְּמִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rə·ḇū yə·mê- yiś·rå̄·ʾēl lā·mūṯ way·yiq·rā liḇ·nōw lə·yō·w·sêp̄ way·yō·mer lōw ’im- nā mā·ṣā·ṯî ḥên bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā śîm- nā yā·ḏə·ḵā ta·ḥaṯ yə·rê·ḵî wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā ‘im·mā·ḏî ḥe·seḏ we·’ĕ·meṯ ’al- nā ṯiq·bə·rê·nî bə·miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: When the time drew near for Israel to die he called his son Joseph and said to him If . . . I have found favor in your eyes put . . . your hand under my thigh and promise to show me kindness and faithfulness Do not . . . bury me in Egypt
verses.literalPt: Chegando-se o tempo da morte de Israel, chamou a seu filho José e disse-lhe: Se agora achei graça aos teus olhos, põe a mão por baixo da minha coxa e usa para comigo de benevolência e de verdade. Rogo-te que não me enterres no Egito;

verses.original: וְשָֽׁכַבְתִּי֙ עִם־ אֲבֹתַ֔י וּנְשָׂאתַ֙נִי֙ מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם וּקְבַרְתַּ֖נִי בִּקְבֻרָתָ֑ם וַיֹּאמַ֕ר אָנֹכִ֖י אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֥ה כִדְבָרֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·ḵaḇ·tî ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯay ū·nə·śā·ṯa·nî mim·miṣ·ra·yim ū·qə·ḇar·ta·nî biq·ḇu·rā·ṯām way·yō·mar ’ā·nō·ḵî ’e·‘ĕ·śeh ḵiḏ·ḇā·re·ḵā
verses.literal: but when I lie down with my fathers carry me out of Egypt and bury me with them Joseph answered I will do as you have requested
verses.literalPt: mas, quando eu dormir com meus pais, levar-me-ás do Egito e enterrar-me-ás no lugar da sepultura deles. Respondeu José: Eu farei como disseste.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הִשָּֽׁבְעָה֙ לִ֔י וַיִּשָּׁבַ֖ע ל֑וֹ וַיִּשְׁתַּ֥חוּ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַל־ רֹ֥אשׁ הַמִּטָּֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer hiš·šā·ḇə·‘āh lî way·yiš·šā·ḇa‘ lōw way·yiš·ta·ḥū yiś·rā·’êl ‘al- rōš ham·miṭ·ṭāh
verses.literal: Swear to me Jacob said So Joseph swore to him and Israel bowed in worship at the head of his bed
verses.literalPt: Pois jura-me, disse Jacó; e jurou-lhe. E inclinou-se Israel sobre a cabeceira da cama.
